display.purpose: Hero identity, page titles, and short high-impact statements.

body.purpose: Reading copy, forms, tool values, and ordinary UI text.

label.purpose: Compact uppercase navigation, metadata, controls, and field labels.

operational.purpose: Dense transcription controls, timeline status, analysis metadata, and transport labels.

motion.name: quick-interaction
motion.purpose: Border, color, and background changes for direct interaction.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action for a task or form.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 2.5rem; border: 1px solid #e3262e; border-radius: 0; padding: 0.7rem 1rem; background: #e3262e; color: #fff; font-family: 'Familjen Grotesk', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; line-height: 1; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background-color 0.16s ease, border-color 0.16s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover, .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { background: #b90f17; border-color: #b90f17; outline: 2px solid #e3262e; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Tool Field
components.description: Square input for compact calculator and tracker forms.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 0.35rem; color: #626262; font-family: 'Familjen Grotesk', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.07em; line-height: 1.1; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-field input { min-height: 2.5rem; border: 1px solid rgba(10, 10, 10, 0.18); border-radius: 0; padding: 0.5rem 0.65rem; background: #f2f2f2; color: #0a0a0a; font: inherit; letter-spacing: 0; text-transform: none; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e3262e; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Primary Navigation Link
components.description: Compact uppercase route link with a signal underline on interaction.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { position: relative; display: inline-block; padding: 0.55rem 0 0.5rem; color: #626262; font-family: 'Familjen Grotesk', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; line-height: 1; text-decoration: none; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-nav-link::after { position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: 0.15rem; left: 0; height: 2px; background: #e3262e; content: ''; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left center; transition: transform 0.16s ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { color: #0a0a0a; outline: 2px solid #e3262e; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-nav-link:hover::after, .ds-nav-link:focus-visible::after { transform: scaleX(1); }

components.name: Post Card
components.description: Click-through article summary with metadata, display title, and plain-language description.
components.html: ARTICLE · JUL 6, 2026CHICAGO 'L' LIVE ARTA live artwork made from real train positions.
components.css: .ds-post-card { display: grid; gap: 1.25rem; min-height: 8rem; border: 1px solid rgba(10, 10, 10, 0.18); border-radius: 0; padding: 0.85rem; background: #f7f7f7; color: #0a0a0a; font-family: 'Familjen Grotesk', Arial, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-post-card strong { font-family: 'Archivo Black', Impact, sans-serif; font-size: 1.15rem; line-height: 1.05; } .ds-post-meta { color: #e3262e; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; } .ds-post-card:hover, .ds-post-card:focus-visible { background: color-mix(in srgb, #f7f7f7 88%, #0a0a0a); border-color: rgba(10, 10, 10, 0.7); outline: 2px solid #e3262e; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Tool Switcher
components.description: Square segmented route switcher for closely related calculator tools.
components.css: .ds-switcher { display: inline-grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); border: 1px solid rgba(10, 10, 10, 0.18); background: rgba(10, 10, 10, 0.18); } .ds-switcher a { min-width: 7rem; padding: 0.55rem 0.8rem; background: #f2f2f2; color: #0a0a0a; font-family: 'Familjen Grotesk', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.07em; line-height: 1; text-align: center; text-decoration: none; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-switcher a + a { border-left: 1px solid rgba(10, 10, 10, 0.18); } .ds-switcher a:hover, .ds-switcher a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e3262e; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-switcher .ds-switcher-active { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #e3262e; color: #e3262e; }

components.name: Workbench Tool Toggle
components.description: Dense two-line command used in the transcription setup band.
components.css: .ds-workbench-toggle { display: grid; min-width: max-content; min-height: 4.3rem; align-content: center; gap: 0.15rem; cursor: pointer; border: 0; border-right: 1px solid rgb(246 246 246 / 0.42); border-radius: 0; padding: 0.55rem 0.8rem; background: #000; color: #f6f6f6; font-family: 'Familjen Grotesk', Arial, sans-serif; text-align: left; } .ds-workbench-toggle span { color: #a7a7a7; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.06em; line-height: 1; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-workbench-toggle strong { color: #ff343d; font-size: 0.84rem; line-height: 1.2; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-workbench-toggle:hover { background: #141414; } .ds-workbench-toggle:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ff343d; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Mobile Workspace Emphasis
components.description: Mobile-only square switch that reallocates height between timeline and analysis without hiding either band.
components.css: .ds-workbench-switcher { display: inline-flex; border: 1px solid rgb(246 246 246 / 0.42); background: #000; } .ds-workbench-switcher button { min-height: 2rem; cursor: pointer; border: 0; border-radius: 0; padding: 0.35rem 0.65rem; background: transparent; color: #a7a7a7; font-family: 'Familjen Grotesk', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-workbench-switcher button + button { border-left: 1px solid rgb(246 246 246 / 0.42); } .ds-workbench-switcher button:hover, .ds-workbench-switcher button.ds-active { background: #141414; color: #f6f6f6; } .ds-workbench-switcher button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ff343d; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Persistent Pitch Readout
components.description: Hz, nearest note, and cents readout paired with the persistent spectrogram crosshair.
components.css: .ds-pitch-readout { display: grid; min-width: 12.75rem; grid-template-columns: 1fr 3.5rem 3.5rem; align-items: baseline; border-left: 1px solid rgb(246 246 246 / 0.42); background: #000; color: #f6f6f6; font-family: 'Familjen Grotesk', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.78rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; text-align: right; } .ds-pitch-readout span, .ds-pitch-readout strong { padding: 0.45rem 0 0.45rem 0.7rem; } .ds-pitch-readout strong, .ds-pitch-readout span:last-child { color: #ff343d; }

narrative.overview: A high-contrast personal project site that treats real work, tools, and ongoing experiments as public signals. The system is direct, flat, and utilitarian, with visual energy concentrated in display typography, precise red accents, and interaction states.
keyCharacteristics: Oversized Archivo Black display type paired with Familjen Grotesk reading and UI text.
Black, white, and gray tonal structure with red used as a rare signal.
Square borders and field-first surfaces with tonal fill reserved for compact controls and labels.
Desktop asymmetry that stacks into practical mobile layouts.
A dense, user-steered signal workspace for local audio, with waveform and pitch evidence kept in one visual stack.

rules.name: The Rare Signal Rule
rules.body: Use red to guide attention, communicate state, or punctuate a key word. Do not use it as ambient decoration or a default section background.

rules.name: The Field-First Fill Rule
rules.body: A broad outlined container uses the page field. Reserve the neighboring neutral surface for compact outlined controls, labels, data cells, and readouts inside it.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Archivo Black is for display moments only. Familjen Grotesk carries all reading and operational UI text; do not introduce a third type family without a distinct role.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Do not add resting shadows, glass layers, or ornamental blur. Depth must explain interaction or content grouping.

rules.name: Probability Playground Literal Statistic Rule
rules.body: Hero statistics in the standalone Probability Playground show the complete human-readable result. Do not use exponents, scientific notation, or magnitude abbreviations; scale a wide literal result responsively instead.

rules.name: The Black Signal Field Rule
rules.body: Transcription is intentionally always dark. Keep its canvases, bands, and transport on pure black; use Dark Surface only for interactive hover or selected emphasis, never as a stack of floating panels.

dos: Use full-width dividers, alignment, and tonal shifts before adding a panel.
Keep broad outlined regions on the page field and use tonal fill only for compact controls or labels.
Keep interactive controls square, bordered, and touch-sized on small screens.
Use red sparingly for emphasis, active state, focus, and meaningful status.
Do keep transcription setup above the signal, the overview above the zoomed waveform, pitch analysis aligned below it, and essential transport fixed at hand on mobile.
Do preserve Hz, note, and cents together when exposing pitch inspection; the crosshair and readout are one persistent state.
donts: Do not introduce rounded SaaS cards, pill controls, or decorative gradient fields.
Do not use red as a generic background or substitute it for hierarchy.
Do not give an outer card and its smaller bordered children the same tonal fill.
Do not animate height, padding, margin, or other layout-driving properties for navigation reveals.
Don't turn the transcription workbench into a marketing landing page, notation editor, or chrome-heavy DAW imitation.
Don't recast the casual preview password as authentication or imply that local audio is uploaded.
